rounds.response:
- Single-page checkout replacing the 3-step flow; support guest checkout and logged-in users with saved-address auto-suggest and an inline address form with client-side validation and edit/select saved-address capability.  
- Payment: implement credit/debit card processing only at launch (PayPal/Apple Pay out of scope), using secure tokenization and client-side payment validation before submitting to the payment API.  
- Shipping & pricing: on ZIP/postcode input call the shipping service to return real-time shipping cost and delivery estimate, and immediately recalc taxes, discounts, and shipping whenever relevant inputs change.  
- UI & errors: sticky order-summary sidebar on desktop and collapsible summary on mobile; show inline, field-level error copy per spec and use a top-of-page banner only for system-level failures.  
- Non-functional & release: meet first-interactive <2.5s on 3G with async third-party scripts, instrument funnel steps and error/validation metrics, and rollout behind a feature flag at 10% traffic with ramp/rollback tied to error and abandonment baselines.
